create_sqlite_dataset: create a SqlIndexDataset from a SQLite metadata file with frame and sequence annotations
filter_dataset_by_category: filter the SqlIndexDataset to only include frames from specified categories using pick_categories
sample_frames_per_sequence: sample a fixed number of frames per sequence using n_frames_per_sequence with a random seed
query_frame_data_by_index: query FrameData objects by ordinal index or sequence name and frame number pair
iterate_sequence_frames_in_order: iterate over frames in a sequence ordered by timestamp and frame number using sequence_frames_in_order
